# Aplica Ltd

> Aplica designs and builds digital solutions tailored to your business — AI agents and automation, product management, software engineering, platform migration and rapid prototyping — founded on 20 years of hands-on delivery experience.

Aplica is a technology & AI consultancy founded in 2015 and relaunched in 2024, based in Coromandel, Mauritius. Our services draw on two decades of experience across software engineering, product leadership and applied AI, delivered on platforms serving over a million monthly users.
